english.note: Use 浸浴 as the all-purpose noun for an immersion or relaxing bath in water.
Use this specifically for bathing by soaking or immersing yourself in water rather than taking a shower.

examples.english: What I want most when I get home is a soak.
examples.traditional: 我返到屋企最想就係浸浴。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 zeoi3 soeng2 zau6 hai6 zam3 juk6

examples.english: Taking a bath is very relaxing in winter.
